easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Mirror Image.
description:
Cast Mirror Image by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Mirror Image. Choose to have Mirror Image enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.
